value.composition_not_inheritance: Domains are COMPOSED by devices, not inherited from. Composition lets a device mix domains (general for help-desk, custom for core work) in the same device. Inheritance forces a choice; composition allows a device to use a domain for limited things without becoming LLM-heavy.
value.custom_domains: Custom per-device domains based on a common one are allowed as experiments. A custom domain overrides the common one's escalation strategy, inheriting everything else. This is composition, not subclassing — the custom domain calls the common one's tools.
value.escalation_location: Escalation and agentic loops can live in the domain OR the device — the domain is the default location, the device overrides when it needs custom behavior. The domain is where escalation lives unless the device has a reason to own it.
value.inference_proxy_pattern: The inference proxy already works this way: domain.resolve() is a call, not a class hierarchy. The domain pattern generalizes what inference_domain already does.
value.progression: A device starts on the general domain and graduates to a specialized one as it matures. The librarian's path: general → research. The aider shim: general → coding. Graduation is a measurable event, not a configuration switch.
value.question_ownership: Each domain naturally owns its question list — connects to question-tree-embeddings-generator via the (question, owner) tuple design. A domain's questions are the questions that domain knows how to escalate.
value.the_test: A domain is correct when: (1) it can be composed by any device without requiring the device to be LLM-heavy; (2) its escalation strategy can be overridden by a custom domain based on it; (3) its question list is expressible as (question, owner) tuples; (4) it does not force a device into a choice between domains — mixing is the normal case.
the_three_foreseeable_domains: GENERAL — baseline LLM capabilities any device can use. The default domain for a device that does not need specialization. A device starts here and graduates when it matures.
CODING — specialized for code work. The aider shim's natural domain, carrying its own escalation strategy (the aider's tool loop, code review, test-fix cycles).
RESEARCH — specialized for research work. The librarian graduates to this from general as it matures. Carries its own question-answering escalation and information-gathering loops.
value.what: A cognition domain is a MACHINE in the complexity axis (tools + glue) that sits above inference_domain and below devices, carrying an escalation strategy and agentic loop. The glue IS the escalation strategy — that is what differentiates domains, not the models they call.
